children: is expanding its Google Vids to enable users with a Google account to generate AI videos at no cost using the Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash model.

Advanced features and expanded usage limits are available to business users on Workspace plans and consumers on Google AI plans. Users can set specific durations for generating clips and create AI video in 1080p HD.

By using the AI prompts, users can generate original clips or modify existing video footage, as well as add personal avatars. All AI-generated video clips will carry a SynthID watermark embedded into the video frame.
The Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite text-to-speech will be added to Google Vids in the future to allow users to convert scripts into natural-sounding voiceovers in more than 100 different languages.
The service has multiple applications, including new product launches, promotion videos for businesses, and advertising local events with ready-to-use video templates.

title: Google expands free AI video generation in Google Vids
